name: Anamim
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: The Anamim were one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. The name refers to an Egyptian people whose exact location is uncertain.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: The Anamim are listed among Mizraim's descendants in the genealogy of Ham.
